versions.changelog:
Initial release of umi-booking (明洞优美皮肤科预约助手):

- Provides a booking assistant for 明洞优美皮肤科 (UMI Clinic) in Myeongdong, Seoul.
- Supports viewing booking guides, opening clinic pages, submitting appointments, consulting customer service, price inquiries, and downloading the app.
- No external dependencies; uses only built-in Node.js modules.
- Multi-language support (Chinese, English) included.
- Processes user queries with clear intent flows for a seamless reservation experience.
